scope: All 42 sequence-family source/expectation pairs in the frozen 548-occurrence DaveBench inventory
reviewer: Codex implement_docs; also the source transcriber author
method: Each literal source and full declared expectation was read in six batches; documented syntax resolved semantics. Source IDs and hashes bind coverage. Findings were not inferred from candidate/reference output or a generator equality test.
independenceLimit: This is a manual self-audit. Pair with the SVG observer author review and parent spot-review; do not describe it as an independent external sign-off or output qualification.
observerLimit: Source fact retention does not qualify an output observer. Open arrows, lifecycle/group ownership, line breaks, numbering and unsupported facts remain unknown until their actual output obligations are qualified. Styles are audited separately.

findings.detail: Implicit participants have the documented default rectangle participant kind; absence from participant-kinds is not a complete kind contract.
-> and --> are solid/dotted lines without arrowheads. Preserve literal sender/receiver in source/native facts; visual endpoints are unordered because direction is not printed.
-) and --) have open asynchronous arrowheads, which cannot be replaced by the generic filled-arrow expectation.
HTML breaks in message, note and aliased actor labels need source-owned line arrays; whitespace-normalized text alone does not prove line breaks.
Resolved type/alias syntax becomes effective kind/node-label facts; an overridden inline alias is provenance, not an additional painted value.
The source comment must not be painted; excluding it from an inclusion-only label list is insufficient.
Named Mermaid HTML entity #infin; denotes the infinity glyph, not the raw token.
